title: A Holiday by the Sea
description: Lucy and her family have a happy week at the seaside.
instructions: Read about Lucy's holiday. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🏖️ Last summer, Lucy and her family went on holiday to the seaside. They stayed in a small hotel near the beach for one week.
Every morning, Lucy and her brother Tom built sandcastles. Their dad took photos. The sand was warm and soft.
On Tuesday, they swam in the sea. The water was cold, but Lucy loved it. Tom found a big blue shell.
On Wednesday, it was windy, so they flew a kite. It was red and yellow. It went very high in the sky.
🐟 On Thursday, they took a boat trip. Lucy saw some dolphins! They jumped out of the water. Her mum was very surprised.
In the evenings, they ate fish and chips near the beach. On Saturday, they went home. Lucy was sad, but she took some shells home.
